## Scope

A sample of 206 graded sets was read again by a second grader. The review provided an independent check of the grading decisions and supported assessment of consistency across the sampled sets. The scope was limited to the graded sets included in the sample. No wider conclusions are drawn here beyond the results of that review.

## Result

Overall agreement was 62.6 per cent. This result summarises the level of agreement identified through the rereading exercise. It should be considered alongside the detailed per-grader information, which provides a more specific view of the findings. Per-grader results are in the attached spreadsheet and are discussed with each grader privately. The spreadsheet is the source for the detailed breakdown, while individual discussions provide an appropriate setting to review each grader’s results.
